attributes.title: ARRS 2027 Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
Radiologists can attend in Denver or online, May 2 to 5, 2027. Meeting rooms and guest rooms share one building, which cuts travel time between sessions, and a thoracic imaging workshop is offered alongside the main schedule.

The activity is designated for a maximum of 150 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits. That high figure is a ceiling, and few people could earn it during the live days alone. The hotel block is $299 until April 7, 2027. Registration is open, and you can switch between in-person and virtual at no cost. ARRS members pay $629 through February 5, 2027, $733 through April 7 and $943 after that; nonmembers pay $1,679, $1,785 or $1,993, and trainee, associate and emeritus members $299, $399 or $599. The late rate is offered for in-person registration only. The thoracic imaging workshop costs an extra $150 for members and $200 for nonmembers.
